extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF text and figure captions; no image-only numeric quantification was invented.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TS-CATH damages gram-negative bacterial envelopes, increasing outer and inner membrane permeability, dissipating membrane potential, and causing cytoplasmic content leakage at super-MIC exposure.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TS-CATH against E. coli E24 and P. aeruginosa P1

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3.6 TS-CATH induced disruption of the bacterial membrane; xml:fig=7:Fig. 6

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct mechanism is limited to tested gram-negative strains and reported assay conditions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At sub-MIC concentrations TS-CATH disrupts bacterial respiratory-chain function, lowers ATP accumulation, alters NADH/resazurin readouts, and inhibits respiratory-chain dehydrogenase activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TS-CATH-treated E. coli E24 and P. aeruginosa P1

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3.7 TS-CATH induced dysfunction of the bacterial respiratory chain; xml:fig=8:Fig. 7A-H

mechanism_claims.limitations: The curation does not infer untested respiratory-chain targets beyond the assays reported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TS-CATH induces intracellular ROS, and ROS scavenging/inhibition partially reduces TS-CATH antibacterial activity, supporting ROS as a contributing antibacterial mechanism.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3.8 TS-CATH promoted antimicrobial effects by inducing ROS; xml:fig=8:Fig. 7I-P

mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS is curated as contributory, not as the sole killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TS-CATH improves outcomes in mouse bacteremia and wound-infection models by reducing bacterial burden and inflammatory readouts; this is efficacy phenotype evidence rather than a separate molecular target claim.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: E. coli bacteremia and P. aeruginosa wound infection mouse models
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo outcomes are not promoted to direct molecular mechanism evidence.
